name: insight-assess
description: Structured decision evaluation — pros/cons, impact assessment, quality analysis, recommendation. Trigger when the user runs /assess or asks for evaluation, comparison, or impact analysis of an approach, decision, option, or implementation. Optional methods: decision tree, SWOT/TOWS, and impact versus effort. Use insight-explore for divergent option generation, insight-critique for focused output review, and insight-adversarial for multi-POV stress testing.
